prompt_inputs.goal: Build muscle mass through strength training with high protein intake

solution_criteria: Meal plan contains exactly 4-5 meals distributed throughout the day
Total daily protein is 150g or higher with protein distributed across all meals (minimum 25g per meal)
Macronutrient ratios align with strength training needs (approximately 30-35% protein, 40-45% carbohydrates, 25-30% fat)
Plan is presented in compact, concise format suitable for quick reference
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete.

prompt_inputs.goal: High-performance swimming training with 2 sessions (morning 6am, evening 5pm) requiring optimal energy and hydration

solution_criteria: Meal plan spans exactly 1 day with 4-5 meals timed strategically around training windows (pre-swim, post-swim)
Includes hydration strategy with specific fluid recommendations for swimming sessions
All meals are quick-digesting and compact, avoiding heavy foods before water training
Respects all dietary restrictions (no dairy, no nuts) while maintaining nutritional balance
